payload.statement:
# Problem: Council review of Chapter 11, Arcane Spells (quarto-book/chapters/11-arcane-spells.qmd)

You are the hol-rulebook council. Audit this chapter as a publishable unit of the Heroes of Legend
TTRPG rulebook and produce a disposition plan. Do NOT fix anything; file findings only.

## Scope
The registered source `11-arcane-spells` (the chapter's .qmd). This chapter is the source of record
for every arcane spell in the game: 10 cantrips (11:31-119) and 30 spells, each a single growing
card carrying a Novice Weak/Standard/Strong block plus Adept and Master lines (11:123-517). It has
40 `===` cards, 2 section headings, 2 tables in total across the file and only two outbound
cross-references (11:19 to the damage budget, 11:21 back to the magic-system chapter).

Other chapters depend on it and mirror it: ch10 (Magic System, the framework chapter that teaches
the spell model and prints Ember Lance and Brimstone Burst in its own table), ch12 (Divine Spells,
the sibling that shares the cantrip rule and the card format), ch19 (GM Guidance, which prints
Brimstone Burst as the worked card-format example), ch20 (Bestiary, which lists NPC spell damage),
ch05 (class abilities keyed to the same budget), ch08 (the budget and ladder), ch13 (conditions,
resistance, combat).

Cross-check against the authoritative chapters only where a claim is canon-determined: disciplines,
the rank ladder, the damage budget and the raise-cost rule ch08; core resolution, tiers, difficulty,
Boon/Bane ch06; magic framework ch10; combat, damage types, resistance and the condition table ch13;
equipment and weapons ch15; armor and DR ch16; class ability tables ch05; advancement and DP ch18;
glossary ch21; the divine mirror ch12.

## Locked conventions the chapter must satisfy (cite the violated convention in every finding)
- **Damage budget is FLAT.** Novice 2/4/6, Adept 6/9/12, Master 9/15/21 on Weak/Standard/Strong.
  No damage dice anywhere in the book; the only sanctioned dice are 3d6 one-roll checks, 4d6 for
  Boon/Bane (keep highest or lowest three) and explicit random-effect tables (d6 criticals).
- **One-roll principle:** the casting roll IS the damage roll. Zero separate damage rolls.
- **Spell card grammar.** A card states `Disciplines`, `Action`, `Range`, `Keywords`, then Weak,
  Standard and Strong, then Adept and Master. The card's TIER equals the number of Discipline ranks
  it requires: Novice 1 rank, Adept EXACTLY 2 ranks, Master EXACTLY 3 ranks (3 different, 2+1, or
  3 same); no single Discipline may exceed rank 3. Costs are the flat 2/4/8 DP with the Level 3 and
  Level 7 gates. An Adept line must be a strict superset of the card's Novice effects and a Master
  line a strict superset of the Adept line: a higher tier may add, never subtract or replace.
- **ZERO flat +N damage riders (book-wide law, weapons rework 2026-08-19).** No card may add a flat
  damage number. The ONLY sanctioned damage booster is the tier bump, always phrased "+1 damage
  tier" (the Overchannel convention). A card whose base hit also deals damage cannot stack a
  recurring damage rider on an off-table sum: base hit plus rider must land on a budget row, or the
  rider must gate on the WEAK result so base plus rider equals a row (a Novice Weak 2 plus a 2 rider
  = 4 is on the row; the same rider gated on Strong is not). Recurring damage over a stated duration
  must total a row (per-round x rounds), and everything a card prints about one effect must sum to
  its row.
- **Compliant patterns NOT to re-flag.** Multi-projectile or multi-layer cards divide the row
  (Magic Missile three darts at 2 each; a wall's layers); per-target damage equals the row for an
  area chain (Chain Lightning); per-round damage equals the row for a persistent zone (Blizzard);
  and an on-row conditional rider (a Fireball's 9 plus 3 at the centre = 12) is fine.
- **ZERO numeric roll modifiers (Boon/Bane law).** A situational bonus or penalty to a ROLL is Boon
  or Bane, never +N or -N. Numbers are for damage, HP, DR, DP, ranges and durations, plus three
  named exceptions: attributes and skill tiers (Novice +1, Adept +2, Master +3), the DA's difficulty
  dial, and a Challenge penalty. Boons and Banes cancel one for one; the potence ladder is
  Boon/Bane 1 = 4d6 keep three, 2 = 5d6, 3 = 6d6, capped at three.
- **Leveled condition vocabulary.** Conditions use the leveled form the ch13 condition table defines
  (Burning 3, Frozen 2, Slowed 5, Asleep 2, Dazed 1) or the binary name exactly (Prone, Frightened,
  Restrained, Blinded, Hidden). Bespoke paraphrases ("take 2 ongoing fire damage", "is Slowed for
  1 round" with no level, "frozen in place") are defects. `Keywords:` lines stay plain tags; the
  card TEXT carries the level. "Slowed 5 for 1 round" IS compliant.
- **Damage types and resistance.** Damage is typed, and resistance or vulnerability halves or
  doubles it (ch13). A card that prints a resistance interaction must match that math.
- **Cross-references:** every `@sec-*` / `@tbl-*` link must resolve to a real label, and no typed
  period or comma may follow a cross-reference (the engine renders its own trailing stop, so
  `@sec-x,` prints a doubled stop and `@sec-x, then` prints "Chapter 10., then").
- **Zero em-dashes in book text (style law, book-wide).**
- **Typst conventions:** exactly one `{=typst}` fence per file with the `# H1` line above it;
  callout bodies in the NAMED `body: [...]` form; every `#table(` carrying `outlined: false`;
  `#label("sec-...")` on the line after its heading.
- **Phantom cards.** Any card this chapter names must exist under that name wherever it is
  referenced, and any card it references must exist in the book. A name colliding with a different
  card in another chapter is a defect. Cross-chapter mirrors of a card this chapter owns must print
  the same numbers (ch10's table, ch19's worked example, ch20's list).

## Findings format (one finding per member this round)
Each finding must be decision-oriented: name the broken value with [11-arcane-spells:LINE], the
expected or correct value, the violated convention, and the minimal fix. Cite the cross-chapter canon
line where the expected value is canon-determined. Recompute every number you check: a card's damage
line, its tier, its Discipline count, its cost and its superset chain must all agree with each other
and with the chapters that mirror them. A finding that cannot state the broken value and the expected
value is not a finding. Do NOT invent defects to look thorough; a chapter with few real problems is
a good outcome.

payload.argument:
Refute. Chapter 11 is not publishable as written, but every defect is local card-grammar work: four blocking patches, four copyedit sweeps, and one question that belongs to the designer rather than to this file. Nothing here forces an outline change or a rebuild of the spell list.

TIER 1, BLOCKING (patch before publish).

(1) Silver Tongue skips a rung. [11-arcane-spells:399] The card runs Weak, Standard, Strong and then jumps straight to its Master line; the Adept line is missing, so the 4 DP purchase has no text of its own and the chain has no middle step for the Master line to build on. Every other growing spell in the chapter prints both rungs, for example Daze (11:410), Phantasmal Image (11:423) and Fade (11:436). Violated convention: the spell-card grammar (the field line, the three outcomes, then the higher-tier additions; ch19:546) read together with the superset rule. The same line compounds it, because the Master result swaps the Strong result's lingering Bane for a Boon instead of adding to it, which is precisely the overwrite the superset rule forbids. Minimal fix: insert an Adept line between 11:397 and 11:399 that extends the Novice effects (longer duration, or a second target), then reword the Master line so it keeps the Bane and gains the Boon.

(2) Glacial Prison's Master line overwrites a lower-tier effect. [11-arcane-spells:212] Broken value: the Master result drops Restrained and substitutes Frozen 2. Expected value: Restrained survives and Frozen 2 is layered on top, the additive shape the chapter already uses at 11:186 and 11:199. Violated convention: a higher rung may add but must never remove or overwrite. Minimal fix: turn 'instead of' into 'and' so the clause reads as an addition.

(3) Acid Splash's Strong line prints an off-row total. [11-arcane-spells:110] Broken value: the base acid damage plus the cling damage comes to 5 + 5 = 10, and no budget row holds 10; 10 is also absent from the 1/3/5 scale the chapter's damaging cantrips use, so the printed effect sits on no row at all. Expected value: a single total that lands on a row, such as a cling gated on the Weak result where base and rider together form a scale value. Violated convention: a rider layered on a damaging hit has to land on a row (or be gated on Weak so the two numbers sum to a row), and all numbers printed for one effect have to add up to that effect's row. Minimal fix: gate the cling on the Weak result, or fold the two numbers into a single printed value.

(4) Static Shock's Standard line carries an unsanctioned flat number. [11-arcane-spells:99] Broken value: a bonus of +1 against metal armor. Read as damage it is a flat +N rider, which the book bans outright because the only sanctioned damage booster is the tier bump; read as a bonus to a check it is a numeric roll modifier, which the Boon/Bane law bans. Expected value: the sanctioned conditional phrasing, one damage tier higher, which canon already uses for a situational boost (ch20:176), or a Bane-based clause. Violated conventions: no flat +N damage riders, and no numeric roll modifiers. Minimal fix: reword the rider.

TIER 2, COPYEDIT (batch in one pass, no design input needed).

(5) Wind Wall prints the same sentence for Weak and Standard [11-arcane-spells:328, 330], so a Standard result changes nothing. Its sibling wall in ch12 escalates across all three bands (ch12:198-200). Minimal fix: give Standard a step up over Weak.

(6) Caustic Mist puts a qualifier in its keyword field [11-arcane-spells:267]; keyword fields hold plain tags and the card text already carries the qualifier at 11:271 and 11:273 (compare the plain Bane tag at 11:326). Minimal fix: the tag alone.

(7) The section caption at [11-arcane-spells:320] ends with a comma where the opening caption at 11:8 does not. Minimal fix: drop the comma.

(8) Unseen Hand presses a named shared effect into a different meaning [11-arcane-spells:379-388]: it lists weights, while Lift X is defined in feet on a held target (ch13:172). Minimal fix: use plain wording for the weight values and keep the named effect only where the card holds a creature.

TIER 3, ROUTE TO THE COUNCIL (does not block this chapter).

(9) The three damaging cantrips print 1/3/5 (11:52, 11:97, 11:106), a scale beneath the Novice row that no chapter names; cantrips carry no tier, no Discipline and no cost, so there is no row to key them to. I am not filing this as a chapter defect: the three cards agree with each other, and keying free, at-will cantrips to the Novice row would make them strictly better than paid Novice attack spells. If the council wants the cantrip floor locked, it belongs in the budget table in ch08, not in this file.

DISPOSITION PLAN. Patch items 1 to 4 (mechanical, in-place rewording, no number needs redesign, and no other chapter depends on the broken text). Sweep items 5 to 8 with the copyedit pass. Log item 9 with the designer for the budget table. Once items 1 to 4 land, the chapter is publishable: its 40 cards recompute against the spine, every mirror agrees, and no other card breaks a locked convention.

VERIFIED CLEAN, with the check I ran.
- Inventory: I counted 40 cards, 10 cantrips and 30 growing spells, matching the intro's own count (11:19); no duplicate names; the chapter names no other card, so there is no phantom-card risk in this file.
- Tier against Discipline count: the 15 one-rank cards key to the Novice row or to a non-damage effect, and the 15 two-rank cards key to the Adept row or to a non-damage effect; no card asks for three ranks, so the rank 3 ceiling holds.
- Tiers against rows: I walked all 30 spells; every Adept line prints the Adept row and every Master line prints the Master row, and no damage dice appear anywhere in the file.
- Cost and gates: no card prints a DP price, so the flat rates and the level gates (ch08:144-146, ch10:46-48) cannot be misprinted here.
- Sanctioned shapes recompute: multi-projectile division (three lances at 11:165-169, three arcs at 11:230-234, two and three darts at 11:347-349), area chains at per-target row value (11:243-249, 11:269-273, 11:295-299), and the two-target pass-through whose rear target takes a lower row value (11:128-130).
- Cross-chapter mirrors: Brimstone Burst (Adept row, and the Master row with Burning 4) matches ch10:75, the ch10 worked example at ch10:135, the ch19 card-format example at ch19:569-573 and the Archmage entry at ch20:146; Ember Lance (Novice row, and the Master row with Piercing 3 and Burning 2) matches ch10:74, ch10:76, ch08:263 and ch20:144; Force Dart's one-Energy Novice key matches ch08:123.
- Conditions: every condition in the chapter is either in the ch13 table or on the binary list (ch13:192-213). The phrase 'loses its Maneuver' is the book's established action-economy idiom (ch09:385, ch09:425), not a bespoke condition, so I did not re-flag it.
- Damage types: fire, cold, lightning, acid, poison, force, necrotic and bludgeoning are all types ch13 names (ch13:150-152), the Mind and Plants keys are now named for the arcane tradition (ch10:101), and the half-damage chains and arcs match the resistance rule (ch13:154).
- Style and structure: zero em-dashes; both cross-references resolve (@sec-damage-budget at ch08:219 and @sec-chapter-magic-system at ch10) and neither is followed by a typed stop; one typst fence (opens at 11:3, closes at 11:517) under the H1 at 11:1; no table or callout block exists for the outlined:false and body:[...] rules to bite on.
- Not re-flagged, with reason: the target-check riders (Agility or Dodge rank resists; Fortitude check or ...) are the book-wide idiom shared with the ch12 sibling (ch12:160, ch12:286) and with the bestiary. ch13:160 reads the one-roll law strictly, so a ruling on target checks is a book-level decision rather than a chapter 11 fix; I flag it for the council instead of filing it as a chapter defect.

payload.argument:
Not publishable as-is. I recomputed all forty cards (tier, discipline count, every damage line, the raise path, and the chapters that mirror this one) and four cards fail on their own printed text, two more need rewording.

1. Acid Splash, 11:110. The Strong result prints a 5-point acid hit and then a second 5-point tick on the target's next turn, so a single cast delivers 10. This is an at-will cantrip with no per-encounter limit (11:27), so a player simply repeats it every round and sustains 10 damage per round from a free ability. Ten appears on no row the book prints, and the extra tick rides on Strong instead of being gated to Weak, so the base-plus-rider test fails both ways. The same line also writes repeating damage as prose rather than as the leveled condition the combat chapter defines for damage over time. Minimal fix: drop the separate tick and print the cling as that leveled condition, with its per-round value equal to the card's own line, so the whole effect totals one row.

2. Glacial Prison, 11:212. The Master entry says Frozen 2 replaces the Restrained the lower results impose. The growth rule for a card is that a higher tier may add and never take away, so a player who pays the Master price loses a control effect they already had. Minimal fix: keep Restrained and add Frozen 2 alongside it.

3. Force Dart, 11:347 and 11:349. Two darts at Adept, three at Master, with nothing saying the printed row is divided among them. Burning Volley and Forked Sky both spell out their split in the card text, so this omission is the outlier. Read per dart, the Master Strong line becomes 21 x 3 = 63, off every row. Minimal fix: state the total and the per-dart value.

4. Silver Tongue, 11:390-399. The card prints Weak, Standard, Strong, then Master. There is no Adept entry, which every other card in this chapter and in the divine twin carries, so a player who buys the Adept rank pays the extra DP and a discipline rank for no printed effect. The card also runs its Standard for 2 turns while its Weak lasts a whole scene, so the middle result is shorter-lived than the weakest one. Minimal fix: add an Adept line that adds to the earlier text.

5. Static Shock, 11:99, attaches a bare +1 damage figure against metal armor. Every damage boost elsewhere in the book is worded as a step up the rows, so this breaks the no-flat-rider law and needs rewording or removal.

Two smaller publishing problems. Wind Wall prints the identical sentence under Weak and Standard (11:328, 11:330), so a Standard result does nothing a Weak one did not. And several cards divide a row into fractions the rules never resolve: three, four and five arcs against 9/15/21 (11:173, 11:238), half of 5 (11:101), half of 21 (11:225), and heal-half on odd rows (11:488, 11:490), while the book's only stated rounding is scoped to resistance.

What survives my testing. Ember Lance and Brimstone Burst match the discipline chapter's row table, the magic chapter's own table, the GM chapter's sample card and the bestiary list. The 2-discipline cards' 6/9/12 opening block is the sibling chapter's pattern, so it is not a fault. Brimstone Burst, Rime Storm, Static Field, Tremor, Force Wave, Caustic Mist and Wall of Cinders sit on their rows, and Burning Volley and Forked Sky state their splits. Ward of Iron's DR rows match the divine ward card. Every condition word I checked (Slowed 5, Frozen 2, Burning 2 and 4, Restrained, Prone, Unconscious) is a real entry in the combat table, so the leveled vocabulary holds up.
